item.title: ATO via open DCR in MCP server
item.description:
Hello Everyone

This writeup will be about how we managed to perform ATO’s on most remote MCP server using their open DCR method to allow the attacker to takeover any user account

MCP DCR stands for Open Dynamic Registration which call allow any user to signup for an MCP server and use the MCP feature on their project using REST API or GraphQL based on the config of each MCP
